follow-up time: From birth until discharge or death during the study period (2009-2012)
outcome: Antibiotic resistance patterns of E. coli isolates
Risk factors for E. coli infection
cohort: 1,768 newborns with birth weight <1.5 kg admitted to five Polish neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) between 2009 and 2012
finding: The study found that antibiotic prophylaxis did not reduce the risk of E. coli infection and that the NICU where the infant was hospitalized was a significant risk factor for infection.
followup_time: Until discharge or death during the study period
